title: Vegner's Rubies
description: A simple mod with simple goals - Improve the Superflat palette.
body:
Have you ever wanted Rubies in Minecraft? A way to get diamonds on Superflat? Or even Axolotls... In One Block? Well, this mod is for you. Introducing Rubies, a Gem collected deep under the ocean floor. Rare like Emeralds, it is often better to trade with Wandering Traders for them. However, a Villager once discovered the true value of Rubies and traded rubies solely.

Out now! Make a Block of Ruby and place it near a Villager to get the all-new Ruby Trader. They will trade Rubies for various things, including Prismarine, Diamonds, and even a secret new wood type!

-Made in MCreator
